ic_device.name: NE555
ic_device.description: The NE555 is a precision timing circuit capable of producing accurate time delays or oscillation. In time-delay or monostable operating modes, the timed interval is controlled by a single external resistor and capacitor network. In the astable mode of operation, the frequency and duty cycle are controlled independently with two external resistors and a single external capacitor.

pins.description: Start of timing input. TRIG < 1/2 CONT sets output high and discharge open

pins.name: THRES
